title: Phase Transitions in Primary Hair Planar Black Holes and Solitons
summary: We present a new family of Ricci-flat black hole and soliton solutions with primary scalar hair in asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) space in $D$ dimensions. By solving the coupled Einstein-scalar field equations, we obtain analytic planar hairy black hole and soliton geometries. In these solutions, the scalar field and curvature scalars remain regular everywhere. We also derive analytic expressions for the mass and free energy, which indicate that the hairy soliton represents the ground state of the system.
